      )

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(amount) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       d.A3 AS state,
       (d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12 AS unemployment_rate_increment_percentage
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loan_count
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id AS identification_number
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND t.amount < (
    SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
    FROM trans AS t2
    WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND t2.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t2.date < '1999-01-01'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp AS d
JOIN account AS a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND dist.A11 > 8000
  AND dist.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT d.A3, AVG(d.A15) AS average_crimes_1995
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS a
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) >= 1997
  )
GROUP BY d.A3;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp p ON p.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996') AS amount_1996,
        SUM(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997') AS amount_1997
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
)
SELECT (amount_1997 - amount_1996) * 100.0 / amount_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM yearly;

SELECT
    (SELECT frequency
     FROM account
     WHERE account_id = 3) AS account_3_statement_frequency,
    (SELECT k_symbol
     FROM trans
     WHERE account_id = 3539
       AND k_symbol IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY k_symbol
     ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS account_3539_debit_purpose;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan AS l
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id
      AND t.operation = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  );

SELECT c.client_id, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.2425 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN card AS ca ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.element = 'o'
      AND a.molecule_id IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM bond
          WHERE bond_type = '-'
      )
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
);

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS average_single_bonds
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
   AND b.bond_type = '-'
  WHERE m.label = '+'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
ORDER BY a.element;

SELECT m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element IN ('i', 's')
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT printf('%.3f', 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id)) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT
  (SELECT bond_type
   FROM bond
   WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
   GROUP BY bond_type
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS majority_bond_type,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010') = 'carcinogenic'
    THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS is_carcinogenic;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS connection_count
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19'
   OR atom_id2 LIKE 'TR%_19';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'
ORDER BY element;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (LOWER(a1.element) = 'p' AND LOWER(a2.element) = 'n')
   OR (LOWER(a1.element) = 'n' AND LOWER(a2.element) = 'p');

WITH double_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '='
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
top_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM double_bond_counts
  WHERE double_bond_count = (
    SELECT MAX(double_bond_count)
    FROM double_bond_counts
  )
)
SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM top_molecules t
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id;

SELECT AVG(bond_count) AS avg_bonds_per_iodine_atom
FROM (
  SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM atom AS a
  LEFT JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'i'
  GROUP BY a.atom_id
);

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
);

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
)
AND a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')
);

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom AS a
JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.element) AS ratio,
       molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY molecule.label;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT name
FROM cards
WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c.name, l.status
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage';

SELECT c.id, c.artist
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL)
  AND l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

WITH ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.uuid) AS ruling_count
    FROM cards AS c
    LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
)
SELECT name, artist, isPromo
FROM ruling_counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM ruling_counts);

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data;

SELECT name, text
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Benalish Knight'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN id END) / COUNT(id) AS percentage_borderless_cards
FROM cards;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN c.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS percentage_french
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS banned_white_border_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND c.borderColor = 'white';

SELECT manaCost
FROM cards
WHERE layout = 'normal'
  AND frameVersion = '2003'
  AND borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability = 'mtgo,paper';

SELECT
    id,
    100.0 * COUNT(*) OVER () / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1
  AND isTextless = 0
ORDER BY id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.setCode) AS translated_set_count
FROM set_translations AS st
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE s.block = 'Commander'
  AND st.language = 'Portuguese (Brasil)';

SELECT DISTINCT c.subtypes, c.supertypes
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE f.language = 'German'
  AND c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND c.supertypes IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE (power IS NULL OR power = '*')
  AND LOWER(text) LIKE '%triggered ability%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS number_of_cards
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'premodern'
  AND r.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c.side IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT f.name AS foreign_name
FROM cards AS c

SELECT
    100.0 * (
        CAST(r853.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)
    ) / CAST(r853.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) AS percent_faster
FROM results AS r853
JOIN results AS r854 ON r854.driverId = r853.driverId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r853.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r853.raceId = 853
  AND r854.raceId = 854;

SELECT name
FROM races
WHERE year = CAST(strftime('%Y', (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races)) AS INTEGER)
  AND CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) =
      CAST(strftime('%m', (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races)) AS INTEGER);

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.name
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = l.raceId
WHERE l.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes);

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.raceId) AS percentage_not_first
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

WITH wins AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
),
most_wins AS (
    SELECT MAX(win_count) AS win_count
    FROM wins
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, MAX(r.points) AS max_points
FROM wins w
JOIN most_wins mw ON w.win_count = mw.win_count
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = w.driverId
JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality;

SELECT DISTINCT r.name
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex'
  AND d.surname = 'Yoong'
  AND res.position < 20;

SELECT r.name, r.year
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = l.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael'
  AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name AS race, res.points
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.year = (
      SELECT MIN(r2.year)
      FROM results res2
      JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceId = res2.raceId
      JOIN drivers d2 ON d2.driverId = res2.driverId
      WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis'
        AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton'
  )
ORDER BY r.round
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix';
SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit';
SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit';

SELECT nationality
FROM drivers
WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dob ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2007
  AND r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT r.name
FROM results AS res
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND res.rank > 0
GROUP BY r.raceId
ORDER BY MIN(res.rank), r.year, r.round
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND r.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

SELECT res.positionOrder
FROM results AS res
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008;

SELECT res.time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId)
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
  AND res.driverId IN (
      SELECT driverId
      FROM results
      GROUP BY driverId
      HAVING COUNT(raceId) > 0
  );

WITH race_results AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.milliseconds, r.time, r.positionOrder
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE ra.year = 2008
      AND ra.round = 1
      AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
champion AS (
    SELECT milliseconds
    FROM race_results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT milliseconds
    FROM race_results
    ORDER BY positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (last_driver.milliseconds - champion.milliseconds) * 100.0
       / last_driver.milliseconds AS percentage_faster
FROM champion, last_driver;

SELECT MAX(cr.points) AS max_points
FROM constructorResults AS cr
JOIN constructors AS c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'British';

SELECT c.name
FROM constructorResults AS cr
JOIN constructors AS c
  ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 291
  AND cr.points = 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS constructor_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.constructorId
    FROM constructors AS c
    JOIN constructorResults AS cr
        ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Japanese'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId
    HAVING COUNT(cr.raceID) = 2
       AND SUM(cr.points) = 0
);

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS completion_percentage
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT AVG(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS average_fastest_lap_speed
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2009;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985
      AND res.laps > 50
) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results AS res
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId)
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN lapTimes AS l ON l.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
  AND l.milliseconds < 120000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS netherlandic_driver_count
FROM (
    SELECT nationality
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
WHERE nationality IN ('Dutch', 'Netherlandic');

SELECT driverRef
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
  AND dob = (
    SELECT MIN(dob)
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German'
      AND dob IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disqualified_finishers
FROM results
WHERE raceId > 50
  AND raceId < 100
  AND statusId = 2
  AND time IS NOT NULL;

WITH youngest AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename, surname
  FROM drivers
  WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY dob DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
first_qualifying AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, MIN(r.date) AS first_date
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY q.driverId
)
SELECT r.year,
       y.forename || ' ' || y.surname AS driver_name,
       r.name AS race_name,
       r.date,
       r.time
FROM youngest y
JOIN first_qualifying f ON f.driverId = y.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.date = f.first_date
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM qualifying q
  WHERE q.driverId = y.driverId
    AND q.raceId = r.raceId
);

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY AVG(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS champion, r.time AS finish_time
FROM races AS ra
JOIN results AS r ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
ORDER BY res.positionOrder
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS score
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.statusId = 3
GROUP BY r.driverId
ORDER BY accident_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(lt.milliseconds)
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    c.name AS circuit,
    r.year,
    r.name AS race,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
    res.fastestLapTime AS lap_record
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND res.rank = 1
  AND res.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.name, r.year;

SELECT l.name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team AS t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.team_long_name, MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT l.name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name,
       CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.2425 AS INTEGER) AS current_age
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', pa.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015;

SELECT l.name, COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY m.league_id, l.name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
      AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN p.player_fifa_api_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT l.name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal);

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1970'
  AND strftime('%m', birthday) = '10';

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas'
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011';

SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN Country AS c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011';

WITH height_extremes AS (
  SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height, MIN(height) AS min_height
  FROM Player
),
selected AS (
  SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name
  FROM Player p
  CROSS JOIN height_extremes h
  WHERE p.height = h.max_height OR p.height = h.min_height
),
player_finishing AS (
  SELECT s.player_api_id, s.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
  FROM selected s
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = s.player_api_id
  GROUP BY s.player_api_id, s.player_name
)
SELECT player_name
FROM player_finishing
WHERE avg_finishing = (SELECT MAX(avg_finishing) FROM player_finishing);

SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) * 1.0 / COUNT(t2.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS t1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE t1.height > 170
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010'
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015';

SELECT player_name, birthday
FROM Player
WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada')
ORDER BY birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate = 'low';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS count_players
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'
  AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT l.name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * (
    AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.overall_rating END) -
    AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)
) / AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END) AS percentage_higher
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel');

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT MAX(ta.chanceCreationPassing) AS highest_chance_creation_passing,
       (SELECT ta2.chanceCreationPassingClass
        FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
        JOIN Team AS t2 ON t2.team_api_id = ta2.team_api_id
        WHERE t2.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
        ORDER BY ta2.chanceCreationPassing DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS chance_creation_passing_class
FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT MIN(pa.date) AS date
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  );

SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT 1.0 * (la.overall_rating - ja.overall_rating) / la.overall_rating * 100 AS percentage_higher
FROM Player_Attributes la
JOIN Player lp ON lp.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
JOIN Player_Attributes ja ON ja.date = la.date
JOIN Player jp ON jp.player_api_id = ja.player_api_id
WHERE lp.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND jp.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND la.date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00';

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT player_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rank
  FROM Player
  WHERE height IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT player_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rank = 1;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'
ORDER BY p.player_name;
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS difference;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'right'
LIMIT 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS t
JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta
  ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        finishing,
        curve,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    p.weight,
    a.finishing AS finishing_rate,
    a.curve AS curve_score
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_attributes AS a
    ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   AND a.rn = 1
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) AS game_count
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY game_count DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      THEN 'in-patient'
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS more_male_patients,
  ABS(
    100.0 * (
      SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
  ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END), 0) AS ratio_inpatient_to_outpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT
    p.Diagnosis,
    l.Date AS Laboratory_Test_Date
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 30609
ORDER BY l.Date;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 500;

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.Date AS medical_laboratory_work_date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_when_initially_arrived
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE upper(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%SJS%'
  AND p.Birthday = (
      SELECT MIN(Birthday)
      FROM Patient
      WHERE upper(Diagnosis) LIKE '%SJS%'
  )
ORDER BY l.Date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age,
       p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_minima AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.Segment,
        AVG(t.total_consumption) AS annual_average
    FROM customer_totals AS t
    JOIN segment_minima AS m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN consumption END) AS consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN consumption END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    Segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    consumption_2013 - consumption_2012 AS increase,
    (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS percentage_increase
FROM changes
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC;
